summary: Koil Energy Solutions, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 1.01) on June 17, 2026, announcing a press release about winning a major project for subsea umbilical handling, spooling, and storage services. The project involves deploying two carousels (one newly acquired, one existing) and includes long-term storage. No financial terms, consideration, or board recommendations were disclosed. The filing is a routine current report on a material definitive agreement (a project award) and does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review.
